description: Swarm orchestrator — decomposes a task into dependency-mapped units, dispatches them serially into isolated git worktrees, merges through deterministic gates, and runs a persona-review panel. Includes /imp-agency: a whole-repo audit that produces an imps-ready remediation plan. (The Claude Code build of this plugin drives the same run from a background Workflow script; here the skill drives it directly.)
name: imps
